subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “She explained that the sculpture represented pages opening in the wind.”?
options: After hearing this, some people still disliked it, but they understood the idea better.
One older student said he understood math better after teaching it.
Some people feel better after talking.
After the contest, Grace said she still did not like standing on stage.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「She explained that the sculpture represented pages opening in the wind. After hearing this, some people still disliked it, but they understood…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「One older student said he understood math better after teaching it.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Some people feel better after talking.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「After the contest, Grace said she still did not like standing on stage.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「She explained that the sculpture represented pages opening in the wind. After hearing this, some people still disliked it, but they understood the idea…」，答案為「After hearing this, some people still disliked it, but they understood the idea better.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「After hearing this, some people still disliked it, but they understood the idea better.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
